玩家角色仅可用于组织成员: The Player role applies only to organization memberships.
仅可访问获准的已发布资源，无后台管理权限。: Access to authorized published resources only; no management permissions.
地址随联盟皮肤站映射自动填充。: Addresses are filled automatically from Union skin-site mappings.
头像保存为 512×512 正方形；保留原图以便重新裁剪。手动修改后不会被网站图: Avatars are saved as 512 x 512 squares. Original images are retained for cropping. Manual changes are protected from website icon synchronization.
固定 1:1 选区；拖动网格、调整滑杆或使用方向键移动。: Use a square crop. Drag the grid, adjust the slider or move with the arrow keys.
图片不属于此组织: The image does not belong to this organization.
头像选区须在图片内，且保持 1:1 比例: The crop must stay inside the image and have a 1:1 aspect ratio.
组织头像已改变，请刷新后重试: The organization avatar changed. Refresh and try again.
Worker 每分钟从联盟 API 同步组织目录；新组织使用 CODE 作为初始: The Worker synchronizes the Union directory every minute. New organizations use their CODE as the initial name and grant no management permissions. Website icons are imported automatically; manual avatars take priority.
同一 CODE 对应多个站点，已跳过自动创建: This CODE identifies multiple sites; automatic creation was skipped.
同名组织冲突或已归档，已跳过: Matching organizations conflict or are archived; skipped.
人工映射地址与上游不同，已保留人工设置: The manual address differs from upstream; the manual setting was preserved.
联盟目录请求失败；保留已有组织和映射，下一分钟重试。: The directory request failed. Existing organizations and mappings are preserved. Retrying next minute.
目录每 60 秒同步。网站头像首次导入后每天检查，失败一小时后重试；裁剪或移除头: The directory synchronizes every 60 seconds. Website icons are checked daily after import and retried after one hour on failure. Cropping or removing an avatar preserves the manual preference.
已安排同步，请等待 Worker 执行: Synchronization scheduled. Waiting for the Worker.
